clips.title: Why the BTS Beats Bangkok Traffic

lines.ja: タイはBTSが地上じゃなくて上空を走ってるので、
lines.en: In Thailand, the BTS runs above ground rather than at street level, so
lines.speaker: Speaker

lines.ja: その分、車の交通がいちいち止まらずに済むので、
lines.en: traffic doesn't constantly have to stop for it,
lines.speaker: Speaker

lines.ja: だいぶそこはいいかなと思うんですけど、
lines.en: so I think that's quite nice, but
lines.speaker: Speaker
